project_title: Taipei Metro Circular Line East Section Counterfactual Single-Track Optimization Study
reference_case: Taipei Circular Line East Section (環狀線東環段 Y30-Y39 connecting Y29 to Y01)

datasets.title: Station Chainage, Geometry, Platform Type, and Elevation Dataset
datasets.source: DORTS Circular Line East Section Comprehensive Planning Report & EIA
datasets.units: Distance: m/km, Elevation: m MSL, Coordinates: m (TWD97) / deg (WGS84)
datasets.license: Taiwan Government Open Data License v1.0
datasets.uncertainty_range: +/- 2% on station chainage due to detailed civil contractor staking

datasets.title: Horizontal Curve Radius, Transition Spirals, and Cant Profile
datasets.source: DORTS Basic Engineering Alignment Drawings & DORTS MRT Alignment Design Manual
datasets.units: Radius: m, Cant: mm, Speed: km/h, Angle: deg
datasets.license: Taiwan Government Open Data License v1.0

datasets.title: Vertical Alignment Gradient and Elevation Profile
datasets.source: DORTS East Section Civil Contract Alignment Specifications (CF710-CF763)
datasets.units: Gradient: permille (‰), Elevation: m MSL, Curve Radius: m
datasets.license: Taiwan Government Open Data License v1.0

datasets.title: Turnouts, Scissors Crossovers, and Special Trackwork Layout
datasets.units: Chainage: km, Speed: km/h, Geometry: Ratio (1:9 / 1:12)

datasets.title: GIS Spatial Alignment Layer and Candidate Single-Track Boundaries
datasets.source: Assembled from TDX Open Data API, DORTS GIS layers, and Survey Centroids
datasets.license: CC-BY 4.0 / Taiwan Open Data License v1.0

datasets.title: railML 3.2 Operational Infrastructure Model
datasets.source: Compiled by Pipeline Data Collection Agent according to railML 3.2 schema

datasets.title: Tunnel Bore Geometric Cross-Sections and Material Specifications
datasets.source: DORTS Shield Tunnel Design Criteria & Tender Package Specifications CF710, CF720, CF763
datasets.units: Dimension: m, Area: m2, Volume: m3/m, Concrete: MPa (C50/60)

datasets.title: Ventilation Shafts, Launching Pits, and Cross-Passage Register
datasets.source: CF763 Muzhishan Contract Documents & EIA Environmental Statement
datasets.units: Chainage: km, Depth: m, Length: m, Dimensions: m

datasets.title: Geotechnical Strata Zones, Permeability, SPT-N, and Lun-tou Fault Parameters
datasets.source: Central Geological Survey (GSMDA) Taipei Basin Core Logs & DORTS Geotechnical Investigation Reports
datasets.units: SPT-N: blows/30cm, Permeability: m/s, Pressure: bar, Strength: MPa
datasets.uncertainty_range: +/- 20% on hydraulic conductivity and fault zone gouge width

datasets.title: IFC4.3 Civil Infrastructure Entity Mapping & Spatial GUID Breakdown
datasets.source: buildingSMART IFC4.3 Rail & Tunnel Standard Schema mapping for Taipei Circular Line

datasets.title: Hitachi 4-Car Driverless EMU Rolling Stock Technical Parameters
datasets.source: Hitachi Rail Italy Circular Line Rolling Stock Technical Manual (CF610/CF617)
datasets.units: Dimensions: m, Mass: kg, Speed: km/h, Accel: m/s2, Power: kW/V
datasets.license: Public Transit System Data / Open Technical Norms

datasets.title: CBTC GoA4 Moving Block Signalling, Headway, and Safety Brake Parameters
datasets.source: IEEE 1474.1 CBTC Standard & DORTS Circular Line Signalling Contract Requirements
datasets.units: Time: s/ms, Distance: m, Speed: km/h

datasets.title: Operational Timetables (Double-Track Baseline vs Counterfactual S1 & S3)
datasets.source: Taipei Metro TRTC Circular Line Operating Schedule & DORTS Service Plan
datasets.units: Headway: s/min, Frequency: trains/hr, Duration: hr, Capacity: pphpd

datasets.title: Station-to-Station Origin-Destination (OD) Travel Demand Matrices
datasets.source: Calibrated from TDX / TRTC Smartcard AFC Validation Data & TRTS-V Macro Transportation Model
datasets.license: TDX Transport Data eXchange Open License

datasets.title: Horizon Demand Growth Scenarios (Opening 2032 to Target Horizon 2051)
datasets.source: DORTS Comprehensive Planning Report Travel Forecast Chapter (目標年140年旅運量預測)
datasets.license: Taiwan Government Open Data License v1.0

datasets.title: 30-Year Lifecycle Cost Comparison (CAPEX, OPEX, Renewal, and Salvage)
datasets.source: Synthesized from Taiwan Public Construction Commission (PCC) Unit Cost Database, MOTC Appraisal Norms
datasets.units: Monetary: TWD Billion (NT$ Billions), Discount Rate: 3.5%
datasets.accuracy_lod: Feasibility & Preliminary Engineering Cost Estimation Class 3 (+/- 15%)

datasets.title: Reliability MTBF, Delay Distributions, NFPA 130 Egress, and Hazard Resilience
datasets.source: NFPA 130 (2023 Edition), Taiwan Mass Rapid Transit Act (大眾捷運法), Taipei Fire Department Life Safety Codes
datasets.units: Time: min, Velocity: m/s, Acceleration: g, Water Level: m MSL
datasets.license: NFPA Standard Open Guidelines / Taiwan Laws & Regulations Database
